mapper.insert: insert into user_award_record(user_id, activity_id, strategy_id, order_id, award_id, award_title, award_time, award_state, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{strategyId}, #{orderId}, #{awardId}, #{awardTitle}, #{awardTime}, #{awardState}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update user_award_record set award_state = 'completed' where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and award_state = 'create'
mapper.select: SELECT award_id AS awardId, award_title AS awardTitle, COUNT(*) AS awardCount FROM user_award_record WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} GROUP BY award_id, award_title
